import sys
import bisect

mod1 = 998244353
mod2 = 1000000007
N = 1000000

def m1(x):
    return x % mod1

ve = [[] for _ in range(11)]
sum_ve = [0] * 11
cnt = 0
tmp = 0
ans = 0

def dfs1(x, v):
    global cnt
    if v > n:
        return
    if x > 6:
        return
    cnt += 1
    val = m1(cnt - v)
    ve[x].append(val)
    sum_ve[x] += val
    for i in range(10):
        dfs1(x + 1, v * 10 + i)

def dfs2(x, v):
    global cnt, ans
    if v > n:
        return
    if x >= 1:
        if v * N * 10 > n and v * N + N - 1 <= n:
            t = 1
            for i in range(7):
                val = m1(cnt - v * t)
                pos = bisect.bisect_left(ve[i], (mod1 - val) % mod1)
                ans = (ans + val * len(ve[i]) + sum_ve[i] - mod1 * (len(ve[i]) - pos)) % mod2
                t *= 10
            cnt += tmp
            return
        cnt += 1
        ans = (ans + m1(cnt - v)) % mod2
    start = 1 if x == 0 else 0
    for i in range(start, 10):
        dfs2(x + 1, v * 10 + i)

def main():
    global n, cnt, tmp, ans, ve, sum_ve
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    dfs1(0, 0)
    tmp = cnt
    cnt = 0
    for i in range(11):
        ve[i].sort()
    dfs2(0, 0)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
